## Averroes on faith

Averroes (1126–1198) approaches faith within Islamic Philosophy. Truth does not contradict truth: demonstration and revelation agree when scripture’s apparent sense is read allegorically for those capable of proof. Assent comes rhetorically, dialectically, or demonstratively according to hearers’ natures. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets faith most directly—useful for searches such as “averroes quotes on faith.”
